rule: Pre-registered 2026-10-21, before any sample run. From the 63 CPU tasks drop cad-model and vpp-loss-divergence (failed the 2026-10-21 oracle/nop preflight), retro-console-soc (load-sensitive oracle) and any task whose Codex or v13 median wall time exceeds 90 min. Then take the shortest tasks (by Codex median) in each Codex bucket: 3 of 5/5, 2 of 4/5, 2 of 3/5, 2 of 2/5, 2 of 1/5, 1 of 0/5. Codex expected passes = sum of rates = 7.0 of 12 (58.3%, vs 58.6% public pass@1).
